LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 1.1.2 TIME RELATED GREETINGS AND FAREWELL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: GREETINGS AND FAREWELL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Le
Topic 1.1: Observing and Articulating signs 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell, part of GREETINGS AND FAREWELL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Le in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: how we greet at different times of the day. 1. How do you greet people when you meet them using words? 2. Why do we greet each other?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 1.1.2 Time related greetings and farewell together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Signing skills as learner practices greeting and responding to others’ greetings

while roleplaying.

● Self-efficacy: Learner knows those around them as they greets the teacher, other learners and people outside the

school in practicing greetings.

Values:
● Respect: Etiquette as learner practices learnt greetings to get to understand the welfare of others and bid others

farewell.

● Unity: Cooperation as learner interacts with others to role play greetings.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner maintains love, peace and unity by showing concern on how others are doing through

greetings.

Link to other Activity Areas

Mathematic Activities as the learner learns about time and different activities related to time

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book,Visual Flashcards, Posters with Illustrations, Interactive Visual Schedule, Digital

Slideshows,Tactile Sign Language Cards, Communication Boards.
